t: The Prysmian 6242Y 6mm² Twin & Earth Cable is a durable flat wiring cable designed for fixed indoor installations. Featuring brown and blue copper cores with a bare earth conductor, it delivers reliable electrical performance for lighting and power circuits. The grey PVC sheath offers robust protection and is easy to strip for quick, efficient installation. Manufactured in the UK to high standards, this 10m coil provides consistent quality and dependable results for professional electrical work.
